notes: Only the upper-left DJ area is redesigned. The original bar and dance floor remain in their exact positions.
Vinyl label and groove markings rotate at 45 RPM. Equipment and tonearms stay fixed.
Each dance-floor phase lasts two frames, retaining the original three lighting changes per second.
The foreground sheet uses full-frame transparency and sits above avatars and below speech bubbles.
Activating the catalog entry saves the background, animated foreground and DJ standing cell together.
The DJ standing cell is col=-1,row=1 at x=135,y=45 on the 540x360 movement grid.
